import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());

        String n_str = "";
        while (n > 0) {
            n_str = n % 10 + n_str;
            n /= 10;
        }

        long[] pw10 = new long[17];
        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; i++)
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        long ans = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); len++) {
            long cur = 0;
            String curst = "";

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < n_str.length() && firstdiff < len; firstdiff++) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst += n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1);
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; lastdig++) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (lastdig == n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;
                    if (len == n_str.length() && lastdig > n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst + (char) ('0' + lastdig);

                    long base = 0;
                    String tmp = "";
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); pos++) {
                        for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < curstp.charAt(pos); dig++)
                            base += count_with_prefix(tmp + dig, n, n_str);
                        tmp += curstp.charAt(pos);
                    }
                    base += len - 1; // all strict prefixes are also smaller

                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = n_str.length(); pos < len; pos++) {
                        variables.add((int) (count_with_prefix(tmp + '0', n, n_str) % 1000000007));
                        tmp += '0';
                    }

                    base += 1; // 1-based, not 0-based
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t = 0; t < variables.size(); t++)
                        variables.set(variables.size() - 1 - t, (int) (variables.get(variables.size() - 1 - t) % 1000000007));

                    base %= 1000000007;
                    if (base < 0)
                        base += 1000000007;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); i++)
                        variables.set(i, variables.get(i) % 1000000007);

                    solve(variables, base, ans);
                }
            }
        }

        // special case, numbers that are a prefix of N:
        long cur = 0;
        String curst = "";

        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); len++) {
            curst += n_str.charAt(len - 1);
            cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1; // 1-based
            String tmp = "";
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); pos++) {
                for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < curst.charAt(pos); dig++)
                    val += count_with_prefix(tmp + dig, n, n_str);
                tmp += curst.charAt(pos);
            }
            val += len - 1; // all strict prefixes are also smaller

            val -= cur;
            val %= 1000000007;
            if (val < 0)
                val += 1000000007;

            ans += val;
        }

        ans %= 1000000007;
        pw.println(ans);

        pw.close();
    }

    public static long count_with_prefix(String s, long n, String n_str) {
        long ans = 0;

        long s_val = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray())
            s_val = 10 * s_val + ch - '0';

        for (int len = s.length(); len <= n_str.length(); len++) {
            if (len < n_str.length())
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            else {
                int t = s.compareTo(n_str.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (t < 0)
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                else if (t == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - s_val * pw10[n_str.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void solve(List<Integer> variables, long base, long ans) {
        int cur, until;

        List<Integer> rem1, rem2;

        int pos = 0;
        while (pos < variables.size()) {
            if (pos == until) {
                rem1.add(cur);
                return;
            }

            int oldcur = cur;
            for (int t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
                pos++;
                brute(pos);
                cur += variables.get(pos - 1);
                if (cur >= 1000000007)
                    cur -= 1000000007;
            }
            cur = oldcur;
        }

        rem2 = new ArrayList<>(rem1);
        cur = 0;
        until = variables.size();
        pos = variables.size() / 2;
        while (pos < variables.size()) {
            brute(pos);
            pos++;
            cur += variables.get(pos - 1);
            if (cur >= 1000000007)
                cur -= 1000000007;
        }

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2)
            totalrsum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= 1000000007)
                j--;

            ans += a * (long) rem2.size() + totalrsum - ((long) rem2.size() - 1 - j) * 1000000007;
        }
    }

    public static void brute(int pos) {
        if (pos == until) {
            rem1.add(cur);
            return;
        }

        int oldcur = cur;
        for (int t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
            brute(pos + 1);
            cur += variables.get(pos);
            if (cur >= 1000000007)
                cur -= 1000000007;
        }
        cur = oldcur;
    }

    static long[] variables;
    static int cur, until;

    static List<Integer> rem1, rem2;
}
